name: clock-clock-24
title: ClockClock 24
description: An animated 24-clock grid that spells out the current time. Cycles through wave, spiral, scatter, and time-display phases. Supports independent light/dark theme via the `theme` prop or inherits from parent's `.dark` class.

light.clock-dial-shadow: inset 0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), inset 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.10), inset 0 -2px 5px rgba(255,255,255,0.12)

dark.clock-dial-shadow: inset 0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.48), inset 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.55), inset 0 -2px 5px rgba(255,255,255,0.04)
